summary: Tested Bankr Bot Claim Fee Monitor end-to-end. 17/17 backend pytest cases passed (root, stats, feed, filters, leaderboard, tokens CRUD/track, search, handle profile, 404s, background poller increment after 22s). Frontend e2e via Playwright verified: all required data-testids present (app-root, app-header, kpi-strip, kpi-total-claims, kpi-total-eth, live-feed, feed-table, leaderboard, tokens-table, add-token-form, add-token-submit), KPI strip renders with live values, feed table populates with 40 rows and auto-refreshes (first row changed after 8s confirming ~6s polling), clicking claimer @handle navigates to /handle/{handle} (rendered profile with tokens & claim history), clicking $TOKEN navigates to /tokens/{address} (recharts bar chart + recent claims rendered), leaderboard page renders ranked claimers in descending order, tokens page renders table + AddTokenForm, valid address submission shows success toast 'Now tracking $TOKEN by @TEST_creator' and updates list, invalid address shows error toast 'invalid base address'. Dark terminal aesthetic with neon green/cyan/yellow accents renders correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI on_event('startup'/'shutdown') hooks instead of lifespan context manager — works but flagged as deprecation. Consider migrating to lifespan async context manager.
Background poller task is not awaited on shutdown (cancel only); add `await _poller_task` with try/except CancelledError for clean shutdown.
No database index on claim_events.timestamp / token_address — pagination + 24h aggregations will degrade as data grows. Add indexes for production.
ETH_PRICE_USD is a module-global mutated by an async background task; fine for single-worker uvicorn but unsafe under multi-worker. Persist in DB or cache.

fetch_bankr_fees is called synchronously inside POST /tokens/track and inside generate_live_event — if api.bankr.bot is slow, write latency spikes. Consider firing & forgetting or background enrichment.
/api/tokens/track returns 200 even on new add — REST best practice is 201 Created.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 10 tokens + 120 historical claim events on startup if collections are empty. Two TEST_ prefixed tokens were added during testing (0xabab...abab and 0xefef...efef with creator TEST_creator). Safe to leave or clean via address filter.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_bankr_api.py is reusable. Background poller test sleeps 22s — total runtime ~24s. App is fully functional: dashboard at / shows KPIs+feed+leaderboard+AddTokenForm; /tokens, /tokens/:address, /leaderboard, /handle/:handle all wired. Toasts use sonner. Frontend uses Vite-CRA hybrid via react-router. AddTokenForm inputs have data-testid 'add-token-address' and 'add-token-handle'.
